## Research objective

State the question, correction, synthesis, or repository outcome and explain why
Research Intelligence owns it.

## Evidence and reasoning

- Identify the controlling or strongest applicable sources.
- Separate source-supported findings from inference, recommendation,
  hypothesis, and speculation.
- Describe material conflicts, limits, uncertainty, counterexamples, and
  negative knowledge.

## Authority and disposition

- [ ] I did not present research as an accepted specification, architecture,
      implementation, roadmap, conformance observation, or product commitment.
- [ ] Downstream disposition is linked to evidence from the owning authority,
      or remains `none`.
- [ ] Materially changed conclusions use explicit supersession rather than
      erasing prior reasoning.

## Verification

- [ ] Citations, quotations, dates, versions, profiles, and implementation
      claims were checked against applicable sources.
- [ ] Inquiry metadata, maturity, horizon, review triggers, and navigation are
      accurate where affected.
- [ ] Local links resolve and every added report or artifact is reachable from
      its inquiry.
- [ ] The diff contains no unrelated edits, sensitive personal data, or
      production/canonical artifacts owned by another repository.

## Related material

Link the inquiry, program, reports, downstream decision, and superseded or
successor material when applicable.
